figurative_meaning_en: opinion of the majority or public opinion
example_sentences_in_bangla: জনমতের প্রতি শ্রদ্ধা রাখলে সরকারের জন্য ভালো।
example_sentences_in_english: Respecting public opinion is good for the government.
Public opinion determines everything in elections.
note: This term is widely used in contemporary Bengali discourse, especially in democratic contexts.
